title: AllOfNestedAnyOfUnevaluated
description: Issue #135: #111's reproducer with the anyOf moved one level down, inside an allOf branch. The branch is merged into this same struct, so its applicator lands here or nowhere -- and extractObjectAnyOfDefs reached it while collectRuntimeBranchChecks did not, which left the keyword judged by the static approximation alone. Through anyOf the approximation admits what it cannot see.
